reviewNotes: HOLD — the University of Rwanda has an official six-year MBChB listing at its College of Medicine and Health Sciences (School of Medicine and Pharmacy, Huye), but the available current official programme record reports tuition as N/A. The admissions pages substantiate Rwanda-school subject combinations and a 2024 domestic cut-off/exam/interview route, yet do not provide a current international MBChB fee schedule, current cycle dates, a programme-specific international route, a confirmed instructional-language statement, or a current programme-accreditation/overseas-recognition record. These omissions make a commercial admissions page unsafe to publish.
